title: Security readiness evidence and rolling onboarding gate
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: This ticket defines the evidence bundle, acceptance criteria, and staged sign-off checklist required to open customer onboarding for Private deployments that require SSO/SAML, role-based access control (RBAC), audit logging, and customer-managed keying (KMS/HSM). The goal is to create a reusable gate that the onboarding team can run through for each customer while enabling a safe rollback path and emergency key-rotation process.
background: As Private deployments scale we need a deterministic, auditable gate for security-sensitive features. Recent pilot customers highlighted gaps in mapping SAML assertions to RBAC roles, inconsistent audit log retention defaults, and unclear procedures for HSM-backed key escrow and emergency rotation. This work consolidates requirements into a single evidence checklist and operational runbook to reduce onboarding friction and compliance risk.
scope: In-scope: SAML IdP mapping guides, RBAC role matrix templates, audit-log retention & tamper-evidence proof, KMS/HSM operational runbook, test harness for end-to-end onboarding evidence collection, and sign-off checklist used by Solutions + Security PMs. Out-of-scope: changes to baseline crypto algorithms or building new KMS providers.
scope_changes: 2025-01-20: Added explicit emergency key rotation procedure after SOC review; 2025-01-28: Narrowed scope to exclude HSM vendor integration work (moved to infra backlog); 2025-02-05: Added requirement for SAML attribute-level mapping test cases following customer feedback.
acceptance_criteria:
1) SSO/SAML: IdP mapping documentation exists for Okta and ADFS with example metadata and assertion samples; automated test validates correct role mapping for 5 sample assertions.
2) RBAC: Role matrix with least-privilege templates and at least three pre-defined roles (admin, operator, auditor) documented; policies testable via policy playground.
3) Audit logs: Demonstrable append-only logs for authn/authz events, exportable to customer SIEM; retention policy defaults to 365 days with an adjustable configuration; tamper-evidence proof available.
4) KMS/HSM: Customer key import/export checklist and HSM-backed encryption workflow documented; emergency key rotation runbook with verification steps and rollback criteria.
5) Evidence bundle: For two pilot customers, produce complete evidence packages (metadata, test results, screenshots, PR links) that satisfy a security reviewer.
6) Operational: Onboarding checklist integrates into Console workflow; sign-off requires Security PM + Solutions lead approvals, recorded in drive and ticket.
7) Tests: Regression tests added to onboarding CI verifying SAML mapping and audit log emission on simulated calls.
signoff_checklist:
- Security PM reviewed and approved evidence bundle.
- Solutions Engineer completed live mapping test with customer IdP.
- Infra verified KMS/HSM operational steps in staging.
- Audit team validated log retention and export.
- Compliance confirmed retention meets EU/UK data residency notes (if applicable).
- Emergency rotation test executed in staging and verified.
- Console flow updated with gating check and documentation links.
- Final sign-off recorded in Confluence with attachments (evidence zip).
test_plan:
1) Unit tests for SAML attribute parsing and role mapping.
2) Integration test: spin up staging tenant, configure IdP metadata, exercise login flows and assert RBAC enforcement.
3) Audit export test: generate events and ingest into a test SIEM endpoint, verify event fidelity and timestamps.
4) KMS/HSM test: import customer-wrapped key into staging HSM emulator, encrypt/decrypt sample payloads, perform emergency rotation, assert continuity and rollback.
5) End-to-end pilot verification checklist executed with two pilot customers and recorded artifacts.
rollout_plan: Phase A (internal validation): run tests in staging and perform tabletop emergency rotation drill (target: 2025-02-10 to 2025-02-17). Phase B (pilot customers): onboard two low-risk customers using the checklist (target: 2025-02-18 to 2025-02-28). Phase C (wider availability): open gate for enterprise onboarding and update Console templates (target: 2025-03-01). Each phase requires the sign-off checklist to be completed and stored in the evidence folder.
